name: Socket
description: Score an npm, PyPI or Go package for supply-chain risk, and read what it published.
long_description: Socket scores open-source packages for the things that make a dependency dangerous — install scripts, obfuscated code, network access that was not there last version — and lets you read the files a package actually published. The package tools need no account; three others are scoped to a Socket organization and will say so. It sees the package names you ask about.
